#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;

struct Node;
struct Edge;

struct Node {
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    int index;
    Node() : index(-1) {}
};

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    Node *from, *to;
    ll flow;
    ll capacity;
    Edge *dual;
    ll cost;
    Edge(Node *s, Node *d, ll c, bool f) : forward(f), from(s), to(d), capacity(c), flow(0), dual(nullptr), cost(0) {}
    ll remaining() const { return capacity - flow; }
    void addFlow(ll amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node*> nodes;
    MaxFlowSolver(int n = 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) addNode();
    }
    virtual ~MaxFlowSolver() {}
    void link(Node *n1, Node *n2, ll capacity, ll cost = 1) {
        Edge *e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true);
        Edge *e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        e12->cost = cost;
        e21->cost = -cost;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
    }
    void link(int n1, int n2, ll capacity) {
        link(nodes[n1], nodes[n2], capacity);
    }
    Node* addNode() {
        Node *n = new Node();
        n->index = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
        return n;
    }
    virtual ll getMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) = 0;
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n = 0) : MaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    virtual pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) = 0;
};

struct Item {
    ll dist;
    int v;
    Item(ll d, int vv) : dist(d), v(vv) {}
    bool operator<(const Item &other) const { return dist < other.dist; }
};

class BinaryHeap {
public:
    vector<Item> heap;
    void add(const Item &e) {
        heap.push_back(e);
        int i = heap.size() - 1;
        while (i > 0) {
            int p = (i - 1) / 2;
            if (heap[i].dist >= heap[p].dist) break;
            swap(heap[i], heap[p]);
            i = p;
        }
    }
    Item poll() {
        Item result = heap[0];
        Item last = heap.back();
        heap.pop_back();
        if (!heap.empty()) {
            heap[0] = last;
            int i = 0;
            int n = heap.size();
            while (true) {
                int left = 2 * i + 1;
                int right = 2 * i + 2;
                int smallest = i;
                if (left < n && heap[left].dist < heap[smallest].dist) smallest = left;
                if (right < n && heap[right].dist < heap[smallest].dist) smallest = right;
                if (smallest == i) break;
                swap(heap[i], heap[smallest]);
                i = smallest;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    bool isEmpty() const { return heap.empty(); }
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    ll minCost;
    EdmondsKarp(int n = 0) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n), minCost(0) {}
    pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) override {
        ll maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
    ll getMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) override {
        int n = nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        ll flow = 0;
        ll cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0);
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;
            BinaryHeap heap;
            heap.add(Item(0, source));
            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                Item item = heap.poll();
                if (item.dist != dist[item.v]) continue;
                Node *u = nodes[item.v];
                for (Edge *e : u->edges) {
                    ll temp = dist[item.v] + e->cost + potential[item.v] - potential[e->to->index];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[e->to->index] > temp) {
                        dist[e->to->index] = temp;
                        parent[e->to->index] = e;
                        heap.add(Item(temp, e->to->index));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                if (parent[i] != nullptr) potential[i] += dist[i];
            ll augFlow = INF;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index)
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge *e = parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

class FastScanner {
public:
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
    FastScanner() { readLine(); }
    void readLine() {
        getline(cin, line);
        iss.clear();
        iss.str(line);
    }
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (!(iss >> token)) {
            readLine();
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        string s = next();
        return stoi(s);
    }
    ll nextLong() {
        string s = next();
        return stoll(s);
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        string s = next();
        return stod(s);
    }
    string readNextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(cin, str);
        return str;
    }
    vector<int> readIntArray(int n) {
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = nextInt();
        return a;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    int N = scanner.nextInt();
    int M = scanner.nextInt();
    int K = scanner.nextInt();
    int C = scanner.nextInt();
    int D = scanner.nextInt();
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) people[i] = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
    Node *src = solver.addNode();
    Node *snk = solver.addNode();
    int amt = 150;
    vector<vector<Node*>> timeNodes(N, vector<Node*>(amt, nullptr));
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; ++j) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], INF, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, (ll)C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int a = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        int b = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < amt - 1; ++j) {
            int prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; ++k) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j+1], 1, (ll)D * k * k - prev);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j+1], 1, (ll)D * k * k - prev);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    pair<ll,ll> ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    cout << ret.second << endl;
    return 0;
}
